subject: ENG
title: (Demo) Reading and writing narratives
source: Demo data written for testing, not EDB text. Build real units from the official PDF with scripts/extract_curriculum.py.

objectives.text: Identify the main idea and supporting details in a narrative text.
Follow the sequence of events using time connectives.
Work out the meaning of unfamiliar words from context.
Write a short narrative paragraph in the past tense.
